measurement: Three alternating repeats, fresh process per 1024-left-source-row case; four warmups, six 200ms iterations. No concurrent local builds/tests/profiling. BenchmarkDotNet in-process toolchain.
database: Disposable Docker PostgreSQL 14.23 (Debian 14.23-1.pgdg13+1); loopback TCP from local host to Docker VM. Container removed after live tests and timing.
boundary: Pool checkout, SQL execution and wire transfer, bounded provider reads, scalar and complete-shape validation, contributor reconstruction, retained RelationQueryOutputRow and DTO arrays; excludes compilation, fixture setup/population and serialization.
authority: Dictionary and ordinal realizations share metadata-first projection, provider execution, scalar catalog, core shape admission, contributor row semantics and DTO materializer. Dictionary mode is internal reference only.
limitations: Unpaged non-temporal direct scalar output, every required field demanded; row-preserving query-row topology. Aggregation and DISTINCT exact contributors explicitly rejected. No whole absent terminal binding. Physical nonnull unique identity evidence required.
